PGE(2)/EP4-cAMP signaling promotes vascular remodeling of the duct arteriosus to promote structural closure of the ductus lumen.

PGE(2)/EP4/cAMP pathway regulates the DA closure by two mechanisms, one is the acute vasodilatory mechanism and the other is the delayed intimal thickening mechanism.

The main takeaway from our work is that
EP4-cAMP signaling is a critical regulator of both functional and anatomical closure of DA, and that EP4-cyclic AMP-PKA signaling promotes DA remodeling to promote anatomical closure.
